r1_formula_sanity_probe.method: one-off independent NumPy calculation of the written spectral adjoint on a random SPD stretch, proper rotation, symmetric local stress, and random deltaF; no QF production helper imported
r1_formula_sanity_probe.interpretation: Checks the algebraic consistency of this written spectral formula for one finite-dimensional sample only. It does not exercise the QF implementation, the J2 return, element force assembly, a plastic history, or qualification.
r1_formula_sanity_probe.scratch_harness_note: An initial scratch calculation mixed eigenbasis components with diagonal entries of the non-diagonal U and failed; the basis mismatch was corrected by using the eigenvalues. Only the corrected values above are reported, and the failed scratch calculation is not evidence about production behavior.

common_metrics.force_scale: F_char = sigma_char * V0^(2/3), sigma_char=max(||T_B||_F, E*||E_B||_F, sigma_y, 1 Pa)
common_metrics.work_scale: W_char=max(||P||_F*||deltaF||_F, ||T_B||_F*||deltaU||_F, 1 Pa*max(||deltaF||_F,||deltaU||_F), 1e-30 Pa); this is work per reference volume
common_metrics.origin_rule: All perturbation lengths use element-local geometry/displacement scales, never max(abs(reference_coordinates)).
common_metrics.threshold_rule: Each criterion below is property-specific. The historical 1e-10 symmetry diagnostic is retained only for asserted symmetric stress measures; it is not a universal tolerance.

checks.oracle: independent SVD/right-polar calculation on bounded 3x3 tensors
checks.metric: relative reconstruction ||F-RU||; orthogonality ||R^T R-I||; symmetry ||U-U^T||; eigmin(U)
checks.acceptance: reconstruction<=1e-12; orthogonality<=1e-12; symmetry<=1e-12*max(||U||,1); all finite; eigmin(U)>0; det(F)>1e-10; ||U-I||_F<=0.05

checks.property: pure rigid rotation, virgin and after plastic preload
checks.oracle: U(QF)=U(F), independent polar SVD; compare committed state before/after spin
checks.acceptance: U/state/stress relative error<=5e-12; |delta alpha|<=5e-13; no plastic increment for an unchanged U

checks.property: objectivity under a superposed spatial rotation of a multi-step history
checks.oracle: independent QF, U, stress push/pull transformations; no production transport helper
checks.metric: U_star-U; state_star-state; P_star-QP; S_star-S; sigma_star-Q sigma Q^T, scaled tensor errors
checks.acceptance: each relative error<=5e-11 over elastic, plastic, unload/reload, and noncoaxial histories

checks.oracle: independent dense solve for S and direct product for Cauchy
checks.metric: relative residual of S=solve(F,P), sigma=P F^T/J, and P=R Pbar

checks.property: physical Cauchy and PK2 symmetry / angular momentum
checks.oracle: uncorrected raw tensors from independently formed exact polar-adjoint P; no symmetrization
checks.metric: relative_skew(S), relative_skew(sigma), ||P F^T-(P F^T)^T||/max(||P F^T||,1 Pa)
checks.acceptance: all three<=1e-10; where tensor norm<1 Pa require absolute skew<=1e-10 Pa; corrected force resultant moment must agree with volume-integrated angular-momentum identity within 1e-9 relative using its characteristic force-length scale

checks.property: polar differential and adjoint work conjugacy
checks.oracle: independent Sylvester solve and central-difference U(F); random normalized perturbations spanning symmetric and skew parts
checks.metric: relative error in deltaU and absolute work residual normalized by W_char

checks.property: incremental-potential gradient versus assembled internal force
checks.oracle: independently coded local radial-return incremental potential differentiated in nodal displacement; not StressPostProcessor or production P helper
checks.metric: ||f_int-f_FD||/max(||f_int||,||f_FD||,F_char); central-difference step plateau and Richardson comparison
checks.acceptance: relative scaled error<=2e-6 at a converged finite-difference plateau on elastic, active plastic, and noncoaxial smooth-branch cases

checks.property: elastic patch response: tension, compression, simple shear, principal/coaxial and noncoaxial
checks.oracle: closed-form local isotropic J2 elastic law and affine constant-stress patch equilibrium
checks.metric: material stress error, force/work identity, symmetry, and element patch-force error scaled by material/force scale
checks.acceptance: stress/work identities<=1e-10; affine patch force error<=1e-10 on each supported element/quadrature fixture; no plastic state change below yield

checks.property: plastic monotone loading, unloading, reverse yield, and noncoaxial multi-increment history
checks.oracle: independently authored tensor radial-return implementation with same frozen discrete strain path and accepted-state sequence
checks.metric: relative stress/Ep error; absolute alpha error; yield residual; dissipation increment; exact state immutability during trial
checks.acceptance: stress/Ep scaled error<=1e-10; alpha absolute error<=1e-12; normalized yield residual<=1e-10 on active branch; dissipation increment>=-1e-12*max(total dissipation,1 Pa); trial does not alter accepted-state bytes

checks.property: raw consistent tangent and force derivative
checks.oracle: independent central directional force differences at four preregistered relative steps using a fixed accepted state
checks.metric: ||K v-K_FD v||/max(||K v||,||K_FD v||,F_char/L_char); raw tangent skew ratio on smooth branches
checks.acceptance: directional error<=2e-5 at a step-size plateau; raw tangent skew<=2e-5 only on smooth branches where the incremental potential Hessian is classical; no symmetrization before reporting; yield switching uses one-sided/generalized derivative checks

checks.oracle: same reference geometry/displacement field translated by a constant vector, independent local length scale
checks.metric: relative difference in F, E_B, T_B, P, and assembled force
checks.acceptance: all relative differences<=1e-9 for translations up to 1e3 characteristic element lengths; failures due conditioning are reported, not hidden by changing thresholds

checks.oracle: existing nonlinear solver tolerances and saved baseline fixtures; separately select legacy and corrected formulation IDs
checks.metric: convergence status, final residual using existing scale, iteration/failure diagnostics, legacy output/state byte-level fixture comparison where deterministic
checks.acceptance: corrected supported fixtures converge under existing controls with final residual meeting the existing solver tolerance; legacy route results remain within the pre-existing regression assertions; no defaults silently change

checks.oracle: independent affine patch and per-family quadrature/force reference
checks.metric: force/work/symmetry metrics for TET4, TET10, HEX8, HEX20
checks.acceptance: each supported family passes A05-A08 and the pre-existing element-specific checks; no inference from one family to another

checks.oracle: accepted-state content hash before/after repeated trials, rejection, commit, rollback; checkpoint identity contract
checks.metric: state hash and formulation/schema identity equality
checks.acceptance: trial/rejection/rollback preserve accepted-state hash exactly; commit applies one accepted state; legacy or unknown checkpoint under corrected formulation yields SAFE_RESUME=NO and FAIL_CLOSED=YES

checks.oracle: constructed NaN/Inf, det floor, strain-cap, non-positive stretch, and malformed-state cases
checks.metric: deterministic rejection code and absence of valid stress output
checks.acceptance: all invalid cases reject before assembling/serializing a valid corrected response; legacy behavior is tested separately and is not broadened

interpretation.analytical_identity: The polar adjoint and stress transformations are mathematical identities under the stated invertibility and smoothness assumptions.
interpretation.numerical_verification: Passing the finite-dimensional or element tests verifies implementation against specified independent oracles only.
interpretation.qualification: No check in this record automatically qualifies the method, closes QF0212 gates, promotes maturity, or establishes industrial/general finite-strain validity.
